competitors.description:
@scoper19008 BitGo: First U.S. qualified custodian to offer institutional Bitcoin staking rewards via Core's Dual Staking; enables secure, compliant access to yields without sacrificing control.

Copper: Provides custody and staking support for institutions; allows staking BTC and CORE directly from custodial accounts to mitigate risk.

Ceffu: Enables secure, non-custodial Bitcoin staking integrated with institutional custody; supports Dual Staking for optimised yields.

Hex Trust: Offers regulated custody and launches Bitcoin-CORE Dual Staking for institutions to generate yield.

Cactus Custody: Integrates for secure Bitcoin yields via Core's Dual Staking model.

Hashnote: Collaborates on revolutionising institutional Bitcoin staking and yield deployment.

Others mentioned in ecosystem updates as integrated for Bitcoin yield solutions: Solv, Everstake, Cobo, KODA, Kiln, InfStones, Figment, OKX, Huobi, Valour, DeFi Technologies, BTCS, and more.

These partnerships focus on institutional adoption, emphasising security, compliance, non-custodial mechanisms, and real BTC yields.
